request: Imagine the black handle is a stand. Add another one on the other side of device in approximately same distane from side wall as the existing one. Remove the Cordholder. Cut the bottom of the handles so it allows the device to be stable on a flat surface.

actions.operation: Add a second instance of the existing black handle/stand.

parameters.placement_distance: Approximately the same distance from the corresponding side wall as the existing handle is from its side wall.

actions.target: The device and a new handle/stand based on the existing black handle.
actions.relational_constraint: Place the new handle on the other side of the device, with approximately symmetric side-wall spacing relative to the existing handle.
actions.unresolved_reference: Identify the existing black handle, the side of the device on which it is located, the opposite side, the relevant side walls, and the handle attachment geometry.
Identify the CAD feature, component, or body named or representing the Cordholder.

actions.operation: Cut the bottom portions of the handles.
actions.target: The existing handle and the newly added handle.
actions.relational_constraint: The resulting handle bottoms must support the device stably on a flat surface.
actions.unresolved_reference: Identify the bottom regions of both handles and determine the cutting plane, orientation, and cut extent required to form suitable coplanar support surfaces.

intention: Use the black handle and the added counterpart as stands.
Allow the device to rest stably on a flat surface.
